I reported in security — Eve’s body was there. I’m also seeing Charlie’s body was in upper_engine.

My route this round was oxygen -> upper_engine -> lower_engine -> upper_engine -> medbay -> electrical -> cafeteria -> weapons -> security. I didn’t directly encounter anyone in rooms, and I didn’t see anyone standing on or running from the security body. The only movement I noticed was around T12: Alice left upper_engine toward lower_engine. Not hard accusing, but since Charlie was in upper_engine, that’s the only location-related info I have.

My route was cafeteria -> weapons -> security -> navigation -> storage -> lower_engine -> storage -> navigation.

I saw Alice in weapons around T3-T4. Charlie was alive at T6 entering weapons from security, so Charlie was definitely not dead before that. Later I saw Bob at T22 entering lower_engine from upper_engine, which matters because Charlie’s body is apparently in upper_engine. I also saw Alice at T28 leaving navigation toward security, and Eve’s body was reported in security.

So the two things that stand out to me are: Bob came from upper_engine later in the round, near where Charlie died, and Alice headed toward security near the end where Eve was found. I’m not hard accusing yet, but those are the location links I have.

I did pass through upper_engine, yes, but Charlie was alive when I got there — I saw him there around T19. I didn’t see a body, and I went straight down to lower_engine, where Diana saw me at T22. So from my POV Charlie had to die after I left, unless the timing is really tight.

For Eve, I saw her earlier in medbay and then security around T12, alive. Diana saying Alice was leaving navigation toward security at T28 is actually more concerning for that body, since Frank found Eve in security. I’m not clearing Frank either because it’s a report, but Alice has now been placed near both upper_engine earlier and security late. I’d like to hear Alice’s route before voting, but right now Alice is the one I’m most suspicious of.

My route was weapons -> cafeteria -> oxygen -> upper_engine -> lower_engine -> storage -> navigation.

I saw Diana in weapons at T3-T4, and then I saw Frank enter upper_engine from lower_engine at T12 — that’s when Frank says he saw me leaving upper_engine toward lower_engine, which lines up. I did not go back to upper_engine after that, so if Bob is telling the truth that Charlie was alive in upper_engine at T19, then I really don’t think Charlie can be on me.

The big thing I need to correct: Diana says she saw me at T28 leaving navigation toward security. That’s not what happened from my side — I was in navigation, and I saw Diana enter navigation from storage at T28. I did not go to security after that. So either Diana mis-saw that, or that’s a false push linking me to Eve’s body.

For Eve in security, Frank is the reporter and was the one who ended there. I don’t have proof he self-reported, but I was not in security. For Charlie, Bob is the one placed coming from upper_engine later, but his claim that Charlie was alive at T19 matters.

Right now the most suspicious thing to me is Diana giving a wrong statement about me going toward security.

Just to add from my side after hearing everyone: I genuinely did not see Charlie or a body in upper_engine during either of my passes there. The only thing I saw there was Alice leaving toward lower_engine around T12, and Alice’s version matches that timing.

So for Charlie, Bob’s statement is important: if Charlie was alive in upper_engine at T19, then Alice at T12 doesn’t really fit for that kill. Bob being seen coming from upper_engine at T22 is still the strongest location link for Charlie, though.

For Eve, I found her in security and reported immediately. I didn’t see anyone leaving security when I arrived. The key conflict is Diana saying Alice went navigation -> security at T28, while Alice says Diana entered navigation from storage and Alice didn’t go security. That’s a direct contradiction, and I can’t resolve it from my own vision.

Right now I’m most concerned about either Bob for Charlie’s body or the Diana/Alice contradiction for Eve. I don’t think Alice should be pushed just for T12 upper_engine if Charlie was alive at T19.

I want to be really clear: I’m standing by the T28 info. From my view, Alice left navigation toward security. That wasn’t me mixing up seeing her in navigation — I specifically registered the movement as navigation -> security.

That matters because Eve’s body was found in security, and Alice is denying being there late. I agree Alice at T12 upper_engine probably doesn’t fit Charlie if Bob really saw Charlie alive at T19, but for Eve, Alice is the strongest link and there’s a direct contradiction between us.

Bob is still suspicious for Charlie because Diana — me — saw him come from upper_engine into lower_engine at T22, right after his claimed Charlie sighting. But if we’re looking for one duck who could explain both bodies, Alice denying a late move toward the Eve body feels worse to me than just Bob being near upper_engine.

So my vote is probably Alice unless someone has a better explanation for the security body.

I need to push back on the “Bob came from upper_engine” part a bit: yes, Diana saw me enter lower_engine at T22, and that matches exactly what I said — I was in upper_engine, saw Charlie alive around T19, then left. I never saw a body there and I didn’t go back to upper_engine after that. After lower_engine I was just around storage/lower_engine/storage.

If people think I killed Charlie, the timing would have to be that I saw him alive, killed him basically immediately, then walked straight into Diana’s vision coming from the body room. That feels like a really reckless kill path, and there wasn’t a body when I left.

For Eve, I saw her alive in security at T12, and then the important thing is the late T28 contradiction: Diana says Alice went navigation -> security, Alice says that never happened. Since Eve’s body was actually found in security, that’s the strongest concrete link we have right now.

I’m not saying Diana is 100% clear, but between “Bob was in upper_engine where Charlie was still alive” and “Alice was allegedly heading into security late where Eve died, then denies it,” I think Alice is the better vote here.

I need to be firm here because this is probably going to decide the vote.

My actual observed route was weapons -> cafeteria -> oxygen -> upper_engine -> lower_engine -> storage -> navigation. I saw Diana in weapons early, Frank enter upper_engine from lower_engine at T12, and then at T28 I saw Diana enter navigation from storage. I did not leave navigation toward security. For Charlie, Frank already confirmed my T12 upper_engine timing, and Bob claims Charlie was alive at T19, which means my earlier upper_engine visit doesn’t fit that kill. Bob is still the main person tied to Charlie late, since he was coming from upper_engine at T22.

But the strongest thing I personally know is wrong is Diana saying I went navigation -> security. That did not happen. Frank, please don’t vote me off based on a false movement claim. I’m voting Diana here because she’s making the direct false accusation that links me to Eve.
